node.title: Schwartz-Zippel on the locus: circuit-carrying configurations are q-power suppressed
node.statement: The determinantal locus is cut by explicit determinants of locator-coefficient matrices of bounded degree; Schwartz-Zippel gives density <= deg/q^c per configuration family. Combined with combinatorial support counting: total circuit count <= poly(n) x (configurations / q^c) — the q-suppression that makes the branch FM-compatible.
